ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. goed

2. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.

3. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.

4. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. quickly
   C. happiness
   D. blue

5. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

6. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.

7. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library?

9. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.

10. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

11. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

12. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pronunciation and Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

12. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.

16. (4 marks)
